dialogues.speaker: Jeht
dialogues.text: Hey, check this out! I've never seen flowers like these before... They're so beautiful, but it's kinda unsettling for them to appear like this in the desert.

dialogues.speaker: Liloupar
dialogues.text: These flowers belong to the mistress... After she fell into a deep slumber, they were said to have disappeared into the desert... I didn't expect to see them again here...

dialogues.speaker: Azariq
dialogues.text: At least this shows that there must be an environment deep in this cave that allows plant roots to absorb nutrients.
